dataset.source_breadth_caveat: Mixed-size adds44 labels; full-N12 adds28. The control is descriptive and does not perfectly match total positive-label count.
dataset.source_base: Identical128 N12 patterns from frozen H3l, plus the complete independently validated44-pattern N11 universe or complete156-pattern N12 universe as declared.

calibration.explanation: q and its symbolic delta=q-1,tau=-q(q-1)/2 are declared structural priors. Every target arm shares the inherited N12 offset128 mean-absolute-field unit. No target fit or label calibration.
